types.name: checkpoints.v1.AssetAmount
types.doc: AssetAmount is a total of one asset.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Asset symbol, for example USDT.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Amount in whole asset units, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without
 separators.

fields.name: usd
fields.doc:
USD value, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without separators or a
 currency symbol. Omitted when the asset had no USD price at the required
 time.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.BiggestTrade
types.doc: BiggestTrade identifies the season's largest trade fill by USD value.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc:
Display symbol of the market, for example BTC-USDT. Empty when the market
 is no longer listed.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: The account's side of the fill.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: UTC time of the fill.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.ChainFlow
types.doc: ChainFlow is the deposits or withdrawals on one Polyester Chain.

fields.name: polyester_chain_id
fields.doc: Polyester Chain id.

fields.name: chain_name
fields.doc:
Display name of the chain, for example Ethereum Sepolia. Empty when the
 chain is not in the current chain catalog.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Number of operations and their USD total on this chain.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.Checkpoint
types.doc:
Checkpoint is one frozen season recap of a root account and all of its
 subaccounts. Only the account owner can read it.

fields.name: number
fields.doc:
Positive checkpoint number. Checkpoint 1 is the first season; numbers
 increase by season.

fields.name: season_start
fields.doc: UTC start of the season, inclusive.

fields.name: season_end
fields.doc: UTC end of the season, exclusive.

fields.name: taken_at
fields.doc: UTC time at which the checkpoint was recorded.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc:
Season trading volume in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal
 string without separators or a currency symbol.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: Number of trade fills.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: Number of orders placed.

fields.name: days_active
fields.doc: Number of UTC days with at least one trade.

fields.name: longest_streak
fields.doc: Longest run of consecutive UTC days with at least one trade.

fields.name: top_pairs
fields.doc:
Markets traded, highest volume first, then by symbol_id ascending. This
 is naturally bounded by the number of markets traded and is not
 paginated.

fields.name: markets_traded
fields.doc: Number of different markets traded.

fields.name: maker_trades
fields.doc: Trade fills on the maker side.

fields.name: taker_trades
fields.doc: Trade fills on the taker side.

fields.name: self_trades
fields.doc: Trade fills where both sides belonged to this account.

fields.name: trades_by_weekday_hour
fields.doc: Trade fills by UTC weekday and hour: exactly 7 entries, Monday first.

fields.name: daily_volume
fields.doc:
Volume and trade fills of every UTC day of the season, oldest first, days
 without trades included.

fields.name: biggest_trade_usd
fields.doc:
Largest single trade fill in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.

fields.name: biggest_trade
fields.doc:
The fill valued biggest_trade_usd, the earliest on a tie. Omitted when no
 fill could be valued.

fields.name: order_types
fields.doc: Placed orders by order type.

fields.name: time_in_force
fields.doc: Placed orders by time in force.

fields.name: tools
fields.doc: Order tool uses.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: Post-only orders placed.

fields.name: amends
fields.doc: Orders amended at least once.

fields.name: filled_orders
fields.doc: Orders that ended fully filled.

fields.name: partially_filled_orders
fields.doc: Orders that ended canceled or rejected after a partial fill.

fields.name: canceled_orders
fields.doc: Orders that ended canceled.

fields.name: rejected_orders
fields.doc: Orders that ended rejected.

fields.name: fill_rate
fields.doc:
Share of placed orders that ended fully filled, a base-10 decimal string
 from 0 to 1.

fields.name: cancel_ratio
fields.doc:
Share of placed orders that ended canceled, a base-10 decimal string from
 0 to 1.

fields.name: median_limit_rest_ms
fields.doc:
Typical time a good-till-canceled or good-till-date limit order rested
 before it filled or was canceled, in milliseconds. Omitted when no such
 order ended in the season.

fields.name: first_trade_at
fields.doc: UTC time of the first trade fill in the season. Omitted without trades.

fields.name: busiest_day
fields.doc:
UTC date with the most trade fills, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted
 without trades.

fields.name: most_active_hour_utc
fields.doc:
UTC hour of day, 0 through 23, with the most trade fills. Omitted without
 trades.

fields.name: vip_tier_at_checkpoint
fields.doc: VIP tier at the moment the checkpoint was recorded, 0 through 10.

fields.name: peak_vip_tier
fields.doc: Highest VIP tier reached during the season, 0 through 10.

fields.name: vip_timeline
fields.doc:
VIP tier changes during the season, oldest first. The first entry is the
 tier at the season start when one was in effect.

fields.name: badges
fields.doc: Badges earned in the season, in badge display order.

fields.name: portfolio_value
fields.doc:
Portfolio value at the end of each hour, oldest first. Hours without a
 recorded value are absent; draw them as gaps, not zero.

fields.name: trading_balances
fields.doc:
Trading balance per asset at the end of the season, valued in USD at that
 time. Shown for the record only.

fields.name: funding_balances
fields.doc:
Funding balance per asset at the end of the season, valued in USD at that
 time. Shown for the record only.

fields.name: deposits
fields.doc: Successful deposits.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.doc: Successful withdrawals.

fields.name: funding_by_day
fields.doc:
Deposit and withdrawal USD values per UTC day with at least one of them,
 oldest first.

fields.name: transfers_in
fields.doc: Transfers received from other accounts, excluding daily claim payouts.

fields.name: transfers_out
fields.doc: Transfers sent to other accounts.

fields.name: internal_transfers
fields.doc: Internal transfers made.

fields.name: daily_claims
fields.doc: Daily claims collected.

fields.name: daily_claim_amounts
fields.doc:
Daily claim totals per asset, by asset ascending, each valued in USD
 when it was paid.

fields.name: inflow_usd
fields.doc:
USD value brought in during the season: daily claim payouts, deposits
 and transfers in, each valued when it happened. Encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol. Omitted when any part had no USD value.

fields.name: outflow_usd
fields.doc:
USD value taken out during the season: withdrawals and transfers out,
 each valued when it happened. Encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal
 string without separators or a currency symbol. Omitted when any part had
 no USD value.

fields.name: net_inflow_usd
fields.doc:
inflow_usd minus outflow_usd, encoded as a base-10 decimal string that
 may be negative. Omitted when either is omitted.

fields.name: final_value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of all trading and funding balances at the end of the season,
 encoded as a base-10 decimal string. Omitted when any balance had no USD
 value.

fields.name: season_result_usd
fields.doc:
Season result: final_value_usd minus net_inflow_usd, encoded as a base-10
 decimal string that may be negative. Omitted when either is omitted.

fields.name: subaccounts
fields.doc: Subaccounts of the account.

fields.name: incomplete
fields.doc:
Values computed from partial evidence, in ascending enum order. Empty
 when every value is exact.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.CheckpointBadge
types.doc:
CheckpointBadge is an achievement earned in one season by meeting a fixed
 threshold. Badges never depend on other accounts' activity. Values are in
 display order.

values.name: FIRST_TRADE
values.doc: At least one trade in the season.

values.name: SEVEN_DAY_STREAK
values.doc: Traded on at least 7 consecutive UTC days.

values.name: THREE_MARKETS
values.doc: Traded at least 3 different markets.

values.name: VOLUME_1000_USD
values.doc: At least 1000 USD of season trading volume.

values.name: HUNDRED_TRADES
values.doc: At least 100 trades in the season.

values.name: TEN_MARKETS
values.doc: Traded at least 10 different markets.

values.name: THIRTY_DAY_STREAK
values.doc: Traded on at least 30 consecutive UTC days.

values.name: EVERY_ORDER_TOOL
values.doc:
Used every order tool: stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, TWAP and
 ladder.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.CheckpointField
types.doc:
CheckpointField names a checkpoint value computed from partial evidence,
 for example trades or holdings that had no USD price at the required time.
 The value shown is a lower bound or omitted; show it with an approximation
 marker rather than hiding the field.

values.name: VOLUME
values.doc: Season volume_usd and the daily volume curve.

values.name: TOP_PAIRS
values.doc: Per-market volume in top_pairs.

values.name: ORDER_TYPES
values.doc: Limit and market order counts.

values.name: TIME_IN_FORCE
values.doc: Time-in-force counts.

values.name: ORDER_STATUS
values.doc:
Filled, partially filled, canceled and rejected order counts, and the
 fill and cancel ratios derived from them.

values.name: TOOLS
values.doc: Order tool counts and the every-order-tool badge.

values.name: MEDIAN_LIMIT_REST
values.doc: Median resting time of limit orders.

values.name: DEPOSITS
values.doc: Deposit count, amounts and USD values.

values.name: WITHDRAWALS
values.doc: Withdrawal count, amounts and USD values.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFERS
values.doc: Internal transfer count.

values.name: DAILY_CLAIM_AMOUNTS
values.doc: Daily claim amounts.

values.name: PORTFOLIO_VALUE
values.doc: Hourly portfolio value curve.

values.name: TRADING_BALANCES
values.doc: Trading balances at the end of the season.

values.name: FUNDING_BALANCES
values.doc: Funding balances at the end of the season.

values.name: TRANSFERS
values.doc: Transfers in and out between this account and other accounts.

values.name: SEASON_RESULT
values.doc: Season inflow, outflow, final value and season result.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.EarnedBadge
types.doc: EarnedBadge is a badge and when it was earned.

fields.name: badge
fields.doc: The badge.

fields.name: earned_at
fields.doc: UTC time the badge's threshold was first crossed, within the season.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.FlowTotal
types.doc:
FlowTotal counts operations and sums their USD values, each valued when it
 happened.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Number of operations.

fields.name: usd
fields.doc:
USD total, encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol. Omitted when any operation had no USD
 value.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.FundingDay
types.doc: FundingDay is the deposit and withdrawal value of one UTC day.

fields.name: date
fields.doc: UTC date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: deposit_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the day's deposits, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol; "0" without a
 deposit. Omitted when a deposit had no USD value.

fields.name: withdrawal_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the day's withdrawals, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol; "0" without a
 withdrawal. Omitted when a withdrawal had no USD value.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.FundingFlowSummary
types.doc: FundingFlowSummary summarizes successful deposits or withdrawals.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Number of successful operations.

fields.name: chains
fields.doc:
Operations per chain, by polyester_chain_id ascending. Operations without
 a known chain are counted only in count.

fields.name: amounts
fields.doc:
Totals per asset, by asset ascending, each valued in USD when it was
 made.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.ListMyCheckpointsRequest
types.doc:
ListMyCheckpointsRequest requests every checkpoint of the authenticated
 caller's root account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public identifier. Checkpoints cover a root account
 and all of its subaccounts, so a subaccount resolves to its root account,
 which must be the caller's own.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.ListMyCheckpointsResponse
types.doc: ListMyCheckpointsResponse contains the caller's checkpoints.

fields.name: checkpoints
fields.doc:
Checkpoints of the root account, newest first. There is at most one per
 season, so the list is naturally bounded and not paginated. Empty when
 the account has no checkpoint, for example when it did not trade in any
 recorded season.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.OrderToolCounts
types.doc:
OrderToolCounts counts distinct uses of each order tool. One strategy that
 generates several orders counts once.

fields.name: stop_loss
fields.doc: Stop-loss uses.

fields.name: take_profit
fields.doc: Take-profit uses.

fields.name: trailing_stop
fields.doc: Trailing-stop uses.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: TWAP uses.

fields.name: ladder
fields.doc: Ladder uses.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.OrderTypeCounts
types.doc: OrderTypeCounts counts placed orders by order type.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Limit orders.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Market orders.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.PairActivity
types.doc: PairActivity is the season activity on one spot market.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc:
Display symbol of the market, for example BTC-USDT. Empty when the market
 is no longer listed.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc:
Season trading volume on this market in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: Number of trade fills on this market.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.PortfolioValuePoint
types.doc: PortfolioValuePoint is the account's portfolio value at the end of one hour.

fields.name: hour
fields.doc: UTC start of the hour.

fields.name: usd
fields.doc:
Portfolio value in USD, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol.

fields.name: approximate
fields.doc:
True when this value is approximate because some holdings could not be
 valued at that hour.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.TimeInForceCounts
types.doc: TimeInForceCounts counts placed orders by time in force.

fields.name: gtc
fields.doc: Good-till-canceled orders.

fields.name: ioc
fields.doc: Immediate-or-cancel orders.

fields.name: fok
fields.doc: Fill-or-kill orders.

fields.name: gtd
fields.doc: Good-till-date orders.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.VIPTierChange
types.doc: VIPTierChange is a VIP tier in effect from one UTC date of the season.

fields.name: date
fields.doc: UTC date from which the tier applies, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.VolumePoint
types.doc: VolumePoint is the trading activity of one UTC day.

fields.name: day
fields.doc: UTC midnight that starts the day.

fields.name: usd
fields.doc:
Settled trading volume of the day in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.

fields.name: approximate
fields.doc:
True when the day's volume is a lower bound because some of its trades
 could not be valued.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc:
Number of trade fills on the day, including fills against the account's
 own orders, which add no volume.

types.name: checkpoints.v1.WeekdayTrades
types.doc: WeekdayTrades counts trade fills on one UTC weekday by UTC hour.

fields.name: hours
fields.doc: Exactly 24 counts, one per UTC hour of the day from 0 through 23.
